basis: Current Data Dragon P/QWER text and complete tooltips, with disputed character fields checked separately. Full character hashes pin reviewed inputs; this is not a full-script correctness certification. Pending fields never imply absence. Conditions describe potential base-kit tools, not ready spells or team strength.

definitions.frontline: 近身防御或近战续战手段；不以数量衡量主坦强度
definitions.engage: 主动接触留人工具；被动、形态、标记及就绪条件仍须满足
definitions.peel: 直接友军治疗/护盾/防御或专门阻断、隔离威胁；普通硬控不自动双计
definitions.sustain: 技能/被动支持的普攻循环、短周期或持续伤害；普通无加成普攻和回血不独立证明
definitions.poke: 不必本人贴身投入的远程命中消耗，仍有射程、目标和站位条件
